triggers.title: New customer
triggers.help: Checks for newly created customer records every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since

input.hint: Fetch new customers from specified time. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

output.label: Created in
output.hint: Store views which the customer is created, e.g. Default Store View
